info.name: Duong Lam - Banking API (MongoDB + JWT)
info.description:
FastAPI + MongoDB Atlas banking API.

Run it: start the server (python -m uvicorn main:app --reload), then right-click the collection > Run collection. Requests run top to bottom; ids are saved in collection variables, so run the whole collection, not single requests out of order.

Folder 0 logs in as admin and saves the JWT in {{token}}. The collection's Authorization tab sends "Bearer {{token}}" on every request; requests that test other users override it.

Folder 6 tests the login system: forgot username/password, reset links, change password, sign out everywhere, lockout, and the staff tools (unlock, temporary password). Reset emails print in the backend terminal.

Folder 7 tests the convenience features: the payee name check, account nicknames and goals, staff notes, and refreshing a session.

Folder 8 deletes what the run created (customers and accounts). Audit records are kept on purpose.

item.name: Forgot password (reset link printed in backend terminal)

request.description: Look in the uvicorn terminal for the EMAIL box: it has a /reset-password?token=... link that works once, for 15 minutes.

exec: pm.test("Says invalid or expired", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().detail).to.include("invalid or has expired"));
pm.test("Needs a letter and a number", () => pm.expect(JSON.stringify(pm.response.json())).to.include("letter and one number"));
pm.test("Says the current password is wrong", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().detail).to.include("current password"));

request.description: Changing the password bumps token_version, so every OLDER token stops working (other devices are signed out).
